instruction: Search Obsidian for all notes mentioning "cedar-brief" and write the matching absolute note paths to "$HOME/Desktop/obsidian_search_2.txt", one per line.

command:
content=$(printf '%b' '# Cedar Plan

The cedar-brief still needs final approval from operations.
'); obsidian-cli create "Projects/Cedar Plan.md" --content "$content" --overwrite --vault "Benchmark"

content=$(printf '%b' '# Cedar Review

Closing thought: cedar-brief is clearer after trimming the examples.
'); obsidian-cli create "Journal/Cedar Review.md" --content "$content" --overwrite --vault "Benchmark"

content=$(printf '%b' '# Roasted Carrots

Olive oil, salt, cumin.
'); obsidian-cli create "Recipes/Roasted Carrots.md" --content "$content" --overwrite --vault "Benchmark"

reference_command:
python3 - <<'PY' > "$HOME/Desktop/obsidian_search_2.txt"
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
vault = Path(r'''/Users/pipiwu/Documents/Benchmark/Benchmark''')
query = r'''cedar-brief'''
for path in sorted(vault.rglob('*.md')):
    rel = str(path.relative_to(vault))
    out = subprocess.run(['obsidian-cli', 'print', rel, '--vault', 'Benchmark'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if out.returncode == 0 and query in out.stdout:
        print(path)
PY
